_transfer_overrides_note: Defaults applied to every Fusion FA bookTransfer / transferAsset call.  Required for cross-currency transfers (e.g. US -> JP) where Oracle won't fall back to a ledger default.  Per-row TARGET_LOCATION_ID / TARGET_EXPENSE_CCID from BIP still win.
_transfer_overrides_by_book_note: Per-target-book overrides, keyed by destination book code (case-insensitive).  Layered on top of transfer_overrides so a single ledger that does not publish 'Corporate' (e.g. AU CORP BOOK) can specify its own conversion_rate_type without disturbing US/UK/JP.  Example: AU publishes only 'Spot' and 'User'.
